test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The erroneous spelling is **"Prisonor"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the spelling of the given words and their meaning.
 
 
• **Listener:- **a person who listens 
 
• **Regular:- **arranged in or constituting a constant or definite pattern
 
• **Prisonor:- **a person legally committed to prison as a punishment for a crime or while awaiting trial. The correct spelling is "**Prisoner"**
 
• **Creator:- **The one who creates anything is called as the creator.
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrectly spelt word is "Prisonor' i.e option no 3. The correct answer will be "**Prisoner"**
